item.title: LeBlanc to meet with Trump's trade czar to talk about CUSMA review
item.description: WASHINGTON — The minister in charge of Canada-U.S. trade said he will be sitting down with U.S. President Donald Trump's trade czar in the coming weeks to discuss the looming review of the Canada-U.S.-Mexico Agreement.

item.title: Carney's closed-door fundraisers a 'step back' for ethics in politics: expert
item.description: OTTAWA — The Liberal party's decision to hold closed-door fundraisers under Prime Minister Mark Carney's leadership is being criticized by experts in political ethics, with one calling the move a "step back.

item.title: Bruce Meyer elevated to players' association interim executive director
item.description: SURPRISE, Ariz. (AP) — Bruce Meyer was promoted to interim executive director of the baseball players’ association on Wednesday, a day after Tony Clark’s forced resignation, a person familiar with the decision told The Associated Press.

item.title: Man facing impaired driving and flight charges after Highway 17 chase
item.description: A search warrant executed at a local motel led to the seizure of various credit cards, bank cards, and personal property believed to be stolen, Ontario Provincial Police said. Investigators also reported finding cannabis during searches of both the hotel room and the vehicle

item.title: Tumbler Ridge victim's mom says truck robbed, wounded daughter's paddle board stolen
item.description: VANCOUVER — The mother of 12-year-old Maya Gebala, who has been holding vigil at her bedside since she was gravely wounded in last week's school shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., says her daughter's paddle board has been stolen from her vehicle.

item.title: B.C. budget 'lands in the middle' between cuts and safeguarding core services: Bailey
item.description: VICTORIA — British Columbia's finance minister started to sell her "tough" budget Wednesday to business leaders who describe her deficit numbers as "scary," while other groups are tabulating the losses.

item.title: Winter mix delivers Ontario freezing rain, blowing Prairie snow and East Coast wallop
item.description: Old Man Winter doled out a medley of punishment across Canada on Wednesday as freezing rain encased southern Ontario, cold and snow swept across the Prairies, and heavy snow blanketed the East Coast.
